title: Sensor
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A single-volume Junji Ito horror story. Kyoko Byakuya, who has lost her memory, is led to a village near Mount Sengoku covered in golden volcanic glass fibres that heighten the senses; villagers gaze at the stars, objects rain from the sky, and a cult called Indigo Shadow, led by Kagero Aido, seeks to use her to reach the Akashic Records. Journalist Wataru Tsuchiyado investigates, and a local legend tells of villagers executed for sheltering a Christian missionary (Viz blurb; Anime UK News).
life_message: The hunger for ultimate knowledge or transcendence can consume those who chase it.
